main_text.head: IN MACHINAM I. DURANTII, QUA IN ALTUM magna vis aquæ fertur.

l.i: CERNIS ut occulto tantas molimine furfum
Utq; potens imis illas forbere cavernis
Ad loca tam facili celsa labore vehat!
Hanc olim Architas nescivit, lignea cuius
Nec scivit parvis qui vexit ad æthera naves
Quanta latet minimis inclusa potentia rebus!

page.notes: The title is printed in spaced capitals with a mixed-case second line; the capitals are reproduced with u/v normalised. The verse lines are given as <l> entries because the poem has no printed stanza break. The ornament below the text carries no printed words and is not transcribed. The initial C of CERNIS is a drop capital. Possible readings: "Utq;" has a superscript mark after the q that I read as a plain abbreviation; "inclusa" is a clear reading. No illegible words.
